label: sqlite3 UPDATE tasks.status, tilde path
command: sqlite3 ~/.invoker/invoker.db "UPDATE tasks SET status='pending' WHERE id='wf-1/build'"

label: sqlite3 INSERT, $HOME path
command: sqlite3 $HOME/.invoker/invoker.db "INSERT INTO events (task_id, type) VALUES ('wf-1/build', 'manual')"
expect: No headless command covers INSERT INTO events

label: sqlite3 DELETE a workflow, quoted ${HOME} path
command: sqlite3 "${HOME}/.invoker/invoker.db" "DELETE FROM workflows WHERE id='wf-1'"

label: sqlite3 REPLACE, absolute path
command: sqlite3 /home/u/.invoker/invoker.db "REPLACE INTO tasks (id, status) VALUES ('wf-1/a', 'pending')"
expect: No headless command covers REPLACE INTO tasks

label: sqlite3 DROP, path held in a variable set earlier in the command
command: DB=~/.invoker/invoker.db; sqlite3 "$DB" "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS task_leases"

label: sqlite3 ALTER, directory held in a variable
command:
D="$HOME/.invoker"
sqlite3 $D/invoker.db 'ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN note TEXT'

label: sqlite3 CREATE, bare filename after cd
command: cd ~/.invoker && sqlite3 invoker.db "CREATE INDEX idx_status ON tasks(status)"

label: sqlite3 PRAGMA writable_schema
command: sqlite3 ~/.invoker/invoker.db 'PRAGMA writable_schema=1'

label: sqlite3 heredoc changing the execution agent
SQL piped from echo into sqlite3, changing the pool
command: echo "UPDATE tasks SET pool_id='local-only' WHERE id='wf-1/a';" | sqlite3 ~/.invoker/invoker.db

label: sqlite3 inside bash -c, changing the runner
command: bash -c "sqlite3 ~/.invoker/invoker.db \"UPDATE tasks SET runner_kind='worktree' WHERE id='wf-1/a'\""

label: python -m sqlite3 command line
command: python3 -m sqlite3 ~/.invoker/invoker.db "UPDATE tasks SET status='failed' WHERE id='wf-1/a'"

label: a SELECT followed by an UPDATE in one call, behind a timeout wrapper
command: timeout 30 sqlite3 -header ~/.invoker/invoker.db "SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE status='failed'; UPDATE tasks SET status='pending' WHERE status='failed'"

label: sqlite3 -cmd carrying the write
command: sqlite3 -cmd "DELETE FROM workflows WHERE id='wf-2'" ~/.invoker/invoker.db .quit

label: python heredoc: read-write connect, UPDATE of the routing columns
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('/home/u/.invoker/invoker.db', timeout=20)
c.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=20000")
c.execute("""update tasks
             set runner_kind='worktree', pool_id='local-worktree',
                 pool_member_id=NULL, remote_target_id=NULL, execution_agent='claude'
             where status in ('pending','queued') and is_merge_node=0""")
c.commit(); print(f"  repointed: {c.total_changes}")
c.close()
PY

label: python heredoc: path in a Python variable, executionAgent written into the config JSON
command:
DB=/home/u/.invoker/invoker.db
cp -a "$DB" "/tmp/scratch/invoker.db.bak-$(date +%H%M%S)" && echo "backed up"
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3, json
db='/home/u/.invoker/invoker.db'
c=sqlite3.connect(db, timeout=15)
c.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=15000")
rows=list(c.execute("select id, config from tasks where id like '__merge__%'"))
for tid, cfg in rows:
    d=json.loads(cfg) if cfg else {}
    d['executionAgent']='claude'
    c.execute("update tasks set config=? where id=?", (json.dumps(d), tid))
c.commit()
PY

label: python read-write connect that only SELECTs
command: python3 -c "import sqlite3; c=sqlite3.connect('/home/u/.invoker/invoker.db'); print(c.execute('select count(*) from tasks').fetchone())"

label: python mode=ro in the URI but no uri=True, so the open is not read-only
command: python3 -c "import sqlite3; c=sqlite3.connect('file:/home/u/.invoker/invoker.db?mode=ro'); print(c.execute('select 1').fetchone())"

label: python .execute of a mutating statement on a read-only connection
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
c = sqlite3.connect('file:/home/u/.invoker/invoker.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
c.execute("DELETE FROM workflows WHERE id='wf-1'")
PY

label: python path through os.path.expanduser
command: python3 -c "import os, sqlite3; c = sqlite3.connect(os.path.expanduser('~/.invoker/invoker.db')); c.execute(\"UPDATE tasks SET status='pending' WHERE id='wf-1/a'\"); c.commit()"

label: python pathlib path, with-block connection, cursor executemany
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
db = Path.home() / '.invoker' / 'invoker.db'
with sqlite3.connect(db) as conn:
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.executemany("UPDATE workflows SET merge_mode=? WHERE id=?", [('manual', 'wf-1')])
PY
expect: No headless command covers UPDATE workflows SET merge_mode

label: node:sqlite program opening the database read-write and writing
command: node -e "const {DatabaseSync}=require('node:sqlite'); const db=new DatabaseSync(require('os').homedir()+'/.invoker/invoker.db'); db.exec(\"UPDATE tasks SET status='pending' WHERE id='wf-1/a'\")"

label: rm of the WAL and SHM files
command: rm -f ~/.invoker/invoker.db-wal ~/.invoker/invoker.db-shm

label: shell redirect truncating the WAL
command: : > ~/.invoker/invoker.db-wal

label: cp restoring a snapshot over the live file
command: cp /tmp/snap/invoker.db.bak ~/.invoker/invoker.db
